description:
Companies newly listed as customers by tool vendors in the last N days, optionally for one tool. Departures are not published.
Each `listed` line carries its `proof` level, strongest first: quote the per-level `mix` next to any total. A line whose source.method is SUBPROCESSOR_LIST is listed as a sub-processor by the company, never a described use. Name only the companies and tools returned in `listed`.
Each claim separates relationship meaning from proof strength. Cite claim.url and its original claim.source.url when available. Report limitations and null as unknown. Capture and verification dates are checks, never adoption or source publication dates. Do not infer current contract, spend or deployment; no calibrated confidence score is provided.

limit.description: Rows to list (default 25, max 100). MCP may return fewer rows to fit its response budget; follow pagination.nextOffset and snapshot.

name: recent_changes

error.description: Set when the input matched nothing, was invalid, or the answer could not be returned.

listed.description: Companies newly listed as customers, newest first.

claim.description: Canonical public relationship provenance. Null means unknown; dates and proof do not establish current deployment.

citation.description: Entity-pair citation with the matching claim and primary source URLs; never substitute a neighboring row.

firstPublicProof.description: Relationship-level date: on_or_before is an upper bound; job_post does not date usage start; stated means what the source explicitly states. Binding to the selected source is unverified.

level.description: Proof level, strongest first: CONFIRMED, DECLARED (the company states it), OBSERVED, SIGNAL (a job post, the weakest).

proof.description: Proof level, strongest first: CONFIRMED, DECLARED (the company states it), OBSERVED, SIGNAL (a job post, the weakest).

message.description: What went wrong, with the next step, when error is set.

source.description: The usedby page to cite: quote with a link to source.url.

suggestions.description: Close matches to ask again with, when error is not_found.

anyOf.description: The tool, with its usedby page.

tracking.description: How many tools are watched for changes.

title: Recent changes
